title: LLM-typical ANSI color helper class pattern
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects the recurring 'Colors' helper class with hardcoded ANSI escape sequences (RED, GREEN, RESET, ...). Almost every LLM-generated CLI re-emits this exact pattern; production code typically uses `colorama` or `rich` instead.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/baz.py.
